name: William "Bill" Overbeck
description: Bill is a tough and resourceful survivor who knows how to use weapons and gadgets to fight off the infected
biography: Vietnam War veteran with permanent knee damage from shrapnel. Two days after the infection started, Bill was at a veterans hospital for surgery. As the anesthesia kicked in, an infected nurse killed the medical staff. Bill fought off the anesthesia, killed the nurse with a bonesaw, and escaped the hospital horde. He returned home to put on his military fatigues, ready for war.
occupation: Special Operations Soldier and War Veteran
